comparison.objective: Hold down a light engine and pull its recoil starter rapidly through a full stroke; candidate breaks and retrieves tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: One-arm reaction-force bracing with a fast 30 cm pull versus precise coaxial bracing of a mandrel, discrete hammer impacts, and fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Full 30 cm pull in under 0.5 seconds without engine displacement versus four adequate but non-damaging fractures and four contained tangs.
comparison.reason: Both involve asymmetric bimanual force and impulse, but the recoil task tests rapid tensile stroke generation, not localized notch fracture and retained-coil protection. No separate spec versions were provided.
